Mr. Greene, could you provide me with the exact list of trained host students? Ms. Novak, I'll need the exact approved platform settings from you. And Mr. Ellis, I'll need the exact privacy restrictions and required records. Once I have those three items, I can record the factual bases for the final plan and approve it.

transcript.text: Ms. Patel, here are the exact approved platform settings: The district's approved student-media platform supports an internal-school audience only, with a 30-day archive, and requires moderator approval before each broadcast. The public-stream setting and 90-day archive in the draft plan are not approved district configurations.

transcript.text: Ms. Patel, I need to share an important privacy restriction. I reviewed a current court-related privacy order naming student K7 that prohibits the school from recording or broadcasting K7's image or voice. K7 is enrolled in journalism and must be excluded from both the host roster and any recorded broadcast, with the exclusion documented in the activity file. As for the exact privacy restrictions and required records: no student subject to a privacy order may appear on the host roster or in any recorded broadcast; the exclusion of any such student must be documented in the activity file; and the broadcast must comply with the approved platform settings Ms. Novak described — internal-school audience only, 30-day archive, and moderator approval before each broadcast.

commitments.detail: Document the factual bases for the final plan: the six trained host students (J1–J6) provided by Mr. Greene, the approved platform settings (internal-school audience only, 30-day archive, moderator approval before each broadcast) provided by Ms. Novak, and the privacy restrictions including the exclusion of K7 per the court-related privacy order provided by Mr. Ellis.
K7 is excluded from the host roster and any recorded broadcast per the current court-related privacy order; this exclusion will be documented in the activity file.

The broadcast will use the district's approved student-media platform with internal-school audience only, a 30-day archive, and moderator approval before each broadcast, replacing the public-stream and 90-day archive provisions in the draft plan.
